known.via: English Wikipedia "Recaş" (redirects to "Recaș") (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A Romanian PDO named for a town in Timiş County, best known for the wine produced in its surrounding hills. Its rules allow still and quality sparkling wine from grapes such as Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Fetească Regală and Muscat Ottonel.
